Privacy & responsible use

Last updated: 31 October 2026.

PGN parsing and Stockfish analysis run in your browser. Chess Lens does not upload your imported games, moves, or player names to an analysis server. Reloading clears the game and its analysis.

Your username, appearance choice and guide preference may be stored on this device in local storage. Clear this site's browser data to remove them. Do not import confidential data on a shared device.

The hosting provider receives normal website requests, including IP address and browser information, and may keep operational or security logs. Chess Lens does not add analytics, advertising trackers or account registration. External links follow the destination's privacy policy.

This is an independent learning tool for completed games. Do not use it for assistance during live games where the platform forbids external help. Suggestions and explanations are estimates and can be wrong.
